transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together because we have a backlog of coated brackets, and the shared paint booth is available this weekend for a campaign to work through it. As Operations Director, I can authorize the campaign and set the operating controls, but before we can proceed, plant policy requires a documented operating plan — and that plan needs sign-off from both maintenance and environmental compliance before the first shift begins. So I need to understand from each of you: what do we need to address to get this plan documented and approved in time for a weekend start?

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance issue before we go any further. The filter needs to be replaced before we can safely run any campaign. The good news is the replacement filter is already in stores and it takes exactly 4 hours to install. I haven't entered the reading in the maintenance system yet, but I'm doing so now so it's on record. We'll need to factor that 4-hour replacement into our timeline, and I can't sign off on any operating plan until that filter is swapped out.
